title: 36th Annual Funds for Furry Friends Gala & Auction
description: Our biggest annual benefit! Join us for dinner, live and silent auctions, and heartwarming shelter rescue stories at the Monroe Golf & Country Club.

title: Spring Microchip & Nail Trim Clinic
description: Low-cost microchipping ($20) and gentle nail trims ($10) by appointment. Keep your pets protected and comfortable.

title: T-Shirt Design Artwork Contest Voting
description: Vote for your favorite 2026 membership t-shirt design! $1 per vote supports shelter flea/tick medication.

title: Kitten Shower & Foster Orientation
description: Learn how to foster orphaned kittens and neonates. Donations of kitten milk replacer (KMR) and heating pads welcome!

title: Doggy Day Out Summer Kickoff
description: Take a shelter dog out for a fun afternoon at Sterling State Park! Help dogs de-stress and show off their leash manners.

title: Paws in the Park Community Walk
description: A 1-mile fun walk with your dogs, agility obstacle demos, vendor booths, and adoptable companion meet-and-greets.

title: Fall Low-Cost Vaccine & Wellness Day
description: Affordable core vaccines, rabies shots, and microchipping in partnership with local community veterinary clinics.

title: Howl-O-Ween Pet Costume Parade
description: Dress up your pets for prizes, treats, and spooky fun! Open to all friendly community pets and alumni.

title: Giving Tuesday Shelter Fund Drive
description: Double your impact! Matching funds help provide winter heat, medical treatments, and nutritious food.

title: Santa Paws Holiday Photos
description: Get holiday photos of your furry family members with Santa! All proceeds benefit emergency medical care.

title: Pavlov's Brewing Pint Night for Paws
description: $1 from every pint sold supports the Monroe County Humane Society medical emergency fund.

title: Empty the Shelters Spring Adoption Event
description: Reduced adoption fees sponsored by Bissell Pet Foundation. Meet your new companion!

title: Annual Humane Society Membership Meeting
description: Annual review of shelter operations, Board of Directors elections, and volunteer service awards.
